research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: NearWave is researching and developing methods, systems, and apparatus for controlling and operating near infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) devices, as described in 'Near infrared spectroscopy device control and operation.' The abstract details scanning operations performed via a client device that manages NIRS device functions. This work highlights NearWave’s focus on handheld device technology for breast disease imaging and the integration of NIRS device control and operation.

overview_description.description: NearWave is involved in developing a device poised to democratize point-of-care diagnostics and imaging in breast cancer. The application allows for real-time visual display of 1D, 2D, and 3D quantitative imaging data.

about_short_description.short_description: NearWave engages in the development of a handheld device for breast disease imaging.

product.name: NearWave Scanner
product.description: A handheld device using frequency domain near infrared spectroscopy (fdNIRS) for non-invasive, deep tissue imaging, providing quantitative data on tissue oxygenation and hemoglobin concentrations.

product.name: Tissue Oximetry
product.description: A service that measures tissue oxygenation, including StO2, HHb, HbO2, and THb, using fdNIRS technology for various clinical applications.

product.name: fdNIRS Technology
product.description: A technology that measures optical properties in deep tissue to provide quantitative metabolic measurements of key biomarkers such as regional oxygen saturation and hemoglobin concentrations.
